title: The bird on the flyers
logline: October: the bird perched on the top edge of the crab-flyer row at Gully's, twenty-six flyers under it, its colors against the shingle. Gully's daughter, thirteen, looking up at it from the dock with a broom. Neither of them remarks.

panels.composition: The shingle wall with its row of crab flyers, the small rainbow bird perched on the top edge of the newest flyer, a thirteen-year-old girl with a broom looking up at it from the dock.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small rainbow bird perched on the top edge of a paper flyer in a long row of flyers on a shingle wall, a thirteen-year-old girl holding a broom looking up at it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: On the flyers. She looks; she doesn't remark.
